title: opcode.support results
description: Output of scripts/probe.mjs. Documentation, not enforced at runtime.

checkedAt.description: When the run finished. The staleness marker.

opcodes.description: Copy of config/opcodes.json, so the file is self-describing.

snippet.description: Bytecode probed. Stack inputs satisfied by PUSH0 so success means supported.

coverage.description: How much of the table reached a verdict. A drop here means endpoints degraded, not that chains changed.

snippetCheck.description: Guard against malformed snippets. suspectSnippets should always be empty.

referenceProbed.description: False means snippets went unverified this run.

suspectSnippets.description: Opcodes reported unsupported on the reference chain, which almost always means a bad snippet rather than a real gap.

chains.description: One entry per chain, TVL descending.

name.description: DefiLlama's name, kept as the display name.

rpcUrls.description: Full verified pool, operator diversified. The probe consumes it in order and stops early, so not all were contacted.

witnesses.description: Endpoints actually contacted, in the order tried.

opcodes.description: The answer. One reconciled verdict per opcode name.

client.description: web3_clientVersion. Cheapest fork-change detector and the first thing to check when a verdict moves.

calibrated.description: Whether this endpoint's answers were allowed to count.

rejectionExample.description: Calibrated only. How this endpoint words a real opcode rejection, captured from the negative control.

rejected.description: Uncalibrated only. Why each strategy was refused. The diagnostic field: 'negative control succeeded' means the endpoint does not execute the code at all.

opcodes.description: Calibrated only. This endpoint's raw observations.

evidence.description: 'executed' on success, otherwise the verbatim node error.

reason.description: unknown only. endpoint-unavailable is a provider refusal that survived retries; unattributable-error is a failure not recognisable as an opcode rejection.

verdict.description: One chain's answer for one opcode, reconciled across witnesses.

status.description: What REPORT.md renders. Only 'confirmed' confidence yields a non-unknown status.

confidence.description: confirmed: two calibrated endpoints from different operators agreed. single-witness: only one endpoint had an opinion. single-operator: two endpoints agreed but share an operator, so they are one witness. witnesses-disagree: contradiction, investigate rather than average. no-calibrated-endpoint: nothing trustworthy answered.

witnesses.description: Endpoints that contributed a usable observation.

operators.description: Distinct operators among them. Independence, not count, is what confirms.

observed.description: single-witness and single-operator only. What was seen, recorded but deliberately not promoted to a status.
